warning.titlePre: Mercedes Vario 512D Injector Seal & Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: Vario 512D engines — OM602 and OM611, across the full production run — commonly show injector seal and timing chain/gear wear over time. This pattern is shared with the equivalent-era Sprinter and is well documented across Mercedes commercial vehicle specialist circles. We replace injector seals, timing chain components, timing gears and gaskets as standard on every Vario 512D rebuild.
include_in_hero_hook: yes — Source: established specialist pattern (per G-BRF), shared with equivalent-era Sprinter. Applies to both OM602 and OM611 — the same pattern is confirmed across the range.
